Code Review

This pull request introduces the ability to skip top-k layers in the DSA token-to-KV pool (DSATokenToKVPool) by adding a skip_topk_layers parameter, optimizing memory allocation and operations like copying and offloading. However, a critical bug was identified in move_kv_cache where token-level indices are used directly to index page-indexed buffers, which will lead to an IndexError on CUDA. This should be resolved by converting the token indices to page indices as suggested.

The reason will be displayed to describe this comment to others. Learn more.

In DSATokenToKVPool, self.index_k_with_scale_buffer is page-indexed with shape (num_pages, cols), where num_pages is scaled down by self.page_size (which is 64 on CUDA). However, tgt_loc_flat and src_loc_flat contain token-level indices (ranging up to size + page_size). Indexing index_k directly with these token indices will cause a guaranteed IndexError: index out of range on CUDA. To fix this, the token indices must be divided by self.page_size to obtain the correct page indices before indexing index_k.

Suggested change
for i, index_k in enumerate(self.index_k_with_scale_buffer):
if self.skip_topk_layers[i]:
continue
index_k[tgt_loc_flat] = index_k[src_loc_flat]
tgt_page_flat = tgt_loc_flat // self.page_size
src_page_flat = src_loc_flat // self.page_size
for i, index_k in enumerate(self.index_k_with_scale_buffer):
if self.skip_topk_layers[i]:
continue
index_k[tgt_page_flat] = index_k[src_page_flat]
